svg.text: Your layout: TP4056 top left, MT3608 turned around under it, ESP32 on the right, sensor board standing at the bottom
turned around: VIN on the left
pins left → right: 5V, TRIG, ECHO, GND
5 V: MT3608 VOUT+ → ESP32 5V and J1 5V
Battery +: TP4056 OUT+ → MT3608 VIN+, R3
Echo: J1 ECHO → R1 → ESP32 IO18
Dot = soldered together. Crossing, no dot = separate
1 Battery + splits: MT3608 VIN+ and R3
3 R3 bottom + R4 top + green wire to IO34
5 MT3608 VOUT− joins the ground line
6 Ground line meets the main ground wire
• R2 goes to the ESP32's other GND pin (right side, top).
All ESP32 GND pins are connected inside the board.
• Check every pin by the label on YOUR board; match J1
to the sensor board's order (5V, Trig, Echo, GND).
• Set the MT3608 to 5.0 V before connecting the ESP32.
• Area used: 34 × 44 holes (about 9 × 11 cm). You can
cut off the rest of your 9 × 15 cm board.
